name: work-plan-action-store
goal: Expose selected-project feature plan selection and approval to app controls without leaking results across project or bridge changes.

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Expose digest-bound local bridge actions to a later review UI; keep mutations and late replies scoped to the selected project and bridge, with no provider launch.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Added a nonvisual action store that checks the visible digest and selected project, forwards only allowed bridge fields, and scopes pending and errors to observed project, bridge and capability changes.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: Nineteen focused store cases passed, including the real Work snapshot boundary, late replies, duplicate actions, unavailable capability and attempts to override the selected project. No provider ran.

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
